headline: None of the three round-6 claims hold on the living tree. SKILL.md still requires git fetch and origin/main; tools/souji-census.sh is absent; kotodama .scratch is a live tree above 16GiB and is not one stable fully classified set. Do not prune. Do not treat unapplied amend diffs as drift zero.

drift_count.note: 14 is this seat's semantic count against HEAD docs and the installed scripts. S92's token count (6 receipt tokens absent from SKILL.md) agrees on the sign, not on the integer. Unapplied diffs are not in the numerator.

c1_drift_rows.contradiction: SKILL requires git fetch before a pushed receipt. Spec and both installed tools forbid git fetch and use existing refs only.

SKILL counts pushed against origin/main. Fleet refs/remotes/origin/HEAD is origin/master. Tools resolve origin/HEAD, then a single origin/* ref, else pushed-unverifiable. Local refs never establish pushed.
SKILL uses the artifact's last commit. Tools use the introducing commit (git log --diff-filter=A).
SKILL stale types include *.tmp, out/, and reports/round-*/**-draft.*. Tools accept a .scratch component, *.out, *.log, *-draft.*, and checkpoint basenames. The sets are not equal.
SKILL ages scratch against the owning lane's last admitted round. Tools use --stale-days, default 1.
SKILL's reference sweep is bare rg -l. Tools exclude souji-shokunin/census, tests, and .ufo-quarantine (round-1 D3).

SKILL says any unpushed commit in the owning repo blocks worktree metadata prune. Tools emit SAFE(metadata-prune) when the registration directory is absent and unique commits versus --all are 0, after a named-branch unpushed check.

SKILL still states lore 19 prunable worktrees, game-dev-2d 5 prunable, kotodama 553M. Measured: lore worktree list is 1 line; game-dev-2d is 4 lines with wt-r98/99/100 locked; kotodama .scratch du -sb is 18598194069.

SCORECARD cites souji-verify.sh 7efda63bd760… and souji-vault-verify.sh d312263a…. Installed hashes are 53239fdfe5bcaaaf448e8525845ab962dd7ab6a4e7f75c0f4f051614f1c99200 and 00d59b1b36d87db37518b5ef9fb98cd472888a075ed7b97bd5b8ff93bd559455. Porcelain for SCORECARD.md was empty at 16:24, so the cited prefixes were still the working tree.
Axis table says calibration 7 and operability 8. Saturation paragraph says operability 7 and calibration 6.
Spec allowlist is bash + coreutils + git + rg. Both installed scripts call grep, find, and xargs.
Spec's stale sweep uses rg --basename. The installed script's own header says that flag does not exist and implements a different sweep. This seat did not re-execute rg --basename.
AGENTS.md names only pushed / moved-to-obsidian / stale. Installed tools also emit metadata-prune. PROVINCE.md does not name that receipt.

SKILL says credential-shaped content is NOT-SAFE. Both tools returned SAFE(moved-to-obsidian) for a synthetic ledger row whose vault path component is credentials/fake.env. The same path as a direct target is secrets-refusal. No real secret was read.

independent_walk.method: os.walk followlinks=False; lstat every entry; header = first 200 bytes of non-secret regular files; secret-shaped path components not opened
independent_walk.uncertainty: st_size was summed per path. Hardlink extras were not subtracted. This number can exceed du -sb. Both this sum and du -sb are above 16GiB and 16GB, so the 16G claim is false either way.

k1.header_class_limitation: The 15 largest files are copies of a 135327186-byte PDF. First 8 bytes are %PDF-1.6. This pass labeled them text because the header has no NUL and does not start with { or #!. Extension bytes still show .pdf = 6805014720 across 840 files. Do not use the text count as a content-type census.

secret_shaped.note: Match is the tool name pattern (*secret* and the other secret-shaped components). Examples are fixture names. Contents were not read. 480 bytes across 60 files is consistent with tiny fixtures, not evidence about real credentials.

k1.why: Peer slices used different frozen path-list hashes (S72 535787 / 36b549b2…, S76 535606 / d47c6727…, S78 531029 / fc8cc8e3…). They cannot be unioned. S82 classified 219 top-level entries on an earlier walk of 535526 files and explicitly did not emit per-file rows. This seat's later walk is another snapshot, not a closed inventory. A later find saw 316 top-level entries versus S82's 219.
k1.removal_authorization: NOT-SAFE. No receipt. Do not prune.

handoff_note: S106 handoff, not a removal authorization. kotodama-shokunin/.scratch is live unpushed work (47 then 49 commits not in remote-tracking refs; dirty porcelain moved 29 → 31 → 23 during this audit). Size is above 16GiB: du -sb at 16:09 was 18598194069; an independent header walk summed 19636385642 apparent file bytes across 536421 regular files (hardlinks not deduped). 60 secret-shaped names (480 bytes) were not opened. 85 symlinks were not followed. 217 embedded .git directories account for 1.15e9 bytes, not the bulk; .pdf apparent bytes are 6.8e9. The round's 16G fully-classified claim is false, and sibling slice files do not form one classification. Do not prune. Do not install a census draft by copying this note.
